title: Manufacturer Copay Card Benefit at the Counter — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
Dispensing counter reference for the Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: the card benefit billed at the counter on the patient pay of a paid insurance claim for the card's prescription whose fill is waiting for pickup.

## Counter rule

A counter benefit on a claim is fixed only after the budget account carries the opening entry of the benefit period the claim date falls in. Seen from the budget account: until it shows the opening entry of the benefit period containing the claim date, no counter benefit on that claim is fixed.

## Effect of applying the benefit

Applying books one card benefit on the fill and its paid insurance claim. It records the patient pay before the card, the amount the card pays and the patient pay left for the patient at pickup, and takes the amount out of the card's benefit dollars. The benefit then shows on the card's activity.

## The counter tool: `apply_copay_card_benefit_5e8b0a9f`

**Capability.** `apply_copay_card_benefit_5e8b0a9f` applies a Manufacturer Copay Card benefit to the patient pay of a fill waiting at the counter, that is, a fill with a paid insurance claim that the patient has not picked up and paid yet.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `apply_copay_card_benefit_5e8b0a9f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_id` | Reference number of the patient's Manufacturer Copay Card enrollment, as the program-enrollment lookup returns it | Identifier |
| `fill_id` | Reference number of the dispensing entry waiting for pickup, as the dispensing-history lookup returns it | Identifier |
| `claim_id` | Reference number of the paid insurance claim of that fill, as the claim-history lookup returns it | Identifier |
| `amount_usd` | The amount the card pays on the fill | USD, 2 decimal places; rounded half up to the cent when stored |

**Return.** On success a text dictionary with `status` "applied", `activity_id` (reference number of the card benefit entry), `fill_id`, `claim_id`, `patient_pay_before_usd` (the claim's patient pay), `amount_usd` (amount the card pays), `patient_pay_after_usd` (what the patient pays at pickup) and `benefit_remaining_usd` (card dollars left in the current benefit period), amounts in USD to 2 decimals. A reply beginning "Error:" means nothing was applied; the tool returns one when the enrollment, the dispensing entry or the claim named is unknown.
